fix_name: Fix Undefined receiverId When Sending Voice Message From Map Selection
problem_summary: Clicking a driver on the map does not correctly propagate selected user ID, causing receiverId to be undefined when sending voice message.

agents.responsibility: Ensure selected driver state contains full driver object including UUID.

tasks.title: Fix selected driver state structure
actions: Locate map page state for selectedDriver
Ensure setSelectedDriver(driver) stores full object, not only id
Confirm driver object contains id (UUID) field
If object uses userId instead of id, normalize naming

tasks.title: Fix marker click handler
actions: Ensure onClick marker passes full driver object
Console.log selectedDriver after click to verify structure

definition_of_done: selectedDriver is full object with valid UUID

agents.responsibility: Ensure send button uses selectedDriver safely.

tasks.title: Guard against undefined
actions: Before sending, check if selectedDriver?.id exists
Disable send button if no driver selected
Show toast if no driver selected

tasks.title: Use correct field
actions: If driver object uses userId, update send logic to use selectedDriver.userId
Ensure receiverId is UUID before API call
Add temporary console.log to verify UUID is string

definition_of_done: receiverId is valid UUID when sending message

tasks.title: Type selectedDriver properly
actions: Define SelectedDriver type with required id: string

stop_condition: receiverId is always valid UUID and no undefined errors occur.
